name: Junavelli Winery
description: Junavelli Winery is a family-owned and operated winery located in Brewton, Alabama that specializes in handcrafted sweet and semi-sweet wines. The winery offers wine tastings, live events, and online wine shipping. Experience the rich and diverse selection of wines at Junavelli Winery. From the luscious sweetness of Southern Sweet Blueberry to the delightful notes of Muscadine, our wines are crafted to perfection. Savor the taste of our small-town charm and let your palate be delighted. Immerse yourself in the small-town charm of Junavelli Winery. Our winery is located in the picturesque North Brewton community and offers a serene and welcoming atmosphere. Take a tour, enjoy a tasting, and create lasting memories with friends and family.
